runner_backend.description: Runner backend for this Template Revision, default github. Forgejo delivers a single ephemeral Runner token through protected cloud-init/user-data and Terraform state; never a management token.

alicloud_region.description: Alibaba Cloud region, for example cn-hangzhou. Must contain the selected image and vSwitch.

alicloud_access_key_id.description: RAM AccessKey ID used only by the Terraform provider. Grant scoped ECS lifecycle, image/network describe, tagging and encrypted system disk permissions; never delivered to the guest.

alicloud_access_key_secret.description: RAM AccessKey secret paired with alicloud_access_key_id. Stored as a sensitive publisher binding, never placed in user-data or tags.

alicloud_image_id.description: Publisher-reviewed Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS x86_64 image ID with systemd and an Alibaba Cloud cloud-init datasource supporting IMDSv2. Pin an image in the bound region; this ID is not a disk-content digest. ARM and Windows images are unsupported.

alicloud_vswitch_id.description: Existing vSwitch; determines the availability zone. With default zero public bandwidth it must provide NAT egress to GitHub releases, Actions endpoints and Ubuntu package repositories. Never created or destroyed by this template.

alicloud_security_group_ids.description: Existing security groups in the vSwitch's VPC. Allow required outbound traffic; no inbound access is needed. The template creates no security group or rule.

alicloud_instance_type.description: x86_64 ECS instance type, default ecs.g6.large. The vSwitch zone must support this type and encrypted cloud_essd system disks.

alicloud_system_disk_size.description: Encrypted cloud_essd system disk size in GiB, default 40; must accommodate the image. Released with the instance. Account KMS activation/authorization may be required.

alicloud_internet_max_bandwidth_out.description: Public outbound bandwidth in Mbps, default 0 (no public IP; requires NAT). Positive values allocate an instance public IP with PayByTraffic billing; no EIP is created.

alicloud_cloud_init_cmd.description: Optional trusted publisher Bash preparation body, run as root before runner installation without a JIT environment or template expansion. Never include credentials. Failure stops bootstrap. The template conservatively limits complete encoded user-data to 16 KiB.
